root.label: NBC early vote analysis of 2026 mail ballot requests and returns

events.label: NBC early vote analysis of 2026 mail ballot requests and returns

slots.name: NC request decline
slots.sentence: The decrease is larger among Democratic registered voters at 40% than among Republican registered voters or independent or third-party registrants at 18% and 23%, respectively.

slots.name: NC return rate
slots.sentence: Further, the Democratic registrants who have requested mail ballots are more likely to have already returned them in 2026 (22%) than in 2022 (17%).

slots.name: Georgia Harris decline
slots.sentence: As in North Carolina, the analysis shows that mail ballot requests are down more in precincts that overwhelmingly supported Kamala Harris (52%) than in precincts that overwhelmingly supported Donald Trump (39%).

slots.name: Virginia Democratic returns
slots.sentence: Relative to 2025, there are more early in-person ballots already cast in precincts that overwhelmingly supported Harris (+10%) in 2024 than in precincts that overwhelmingly supported Trump (-14%).

slots.name: Virginia Republican returns
slots.sentence: compared to 5% fewer returned ballots in the most Republican precincts.

slots.name: Virginia Harris in-person
slots.sentence: Of the four states analyzed, it had the highest share of ballots cast by mail in the 2024 presidential election — 27%, versus Virginia at 11%, North Carolina at 5% and Georgia at 5%.
